concept.reason: Actual named skull and mounted skeleton plus AMNH scientific life-art give adequate original gate references; no additional concept image required.

scope: Whole slender long-legged hornless running-rhino reconstruction with three toes on every foot.

scientific_limits.en: Whole living reconstruction, not an articulated single specimen or scan. AMNH1480 skull and LACM3342/42889 skeletal mount are separate references. Skull250mm is approximate projection from an image ruler; body dimensions are artistic estimates consistent with pony-sized museum description, not measured mounted bones. Soft tissue, ears, tail covering and colors are inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整活体复原，非单一完整标本或扫描。AMNH1480颅与LACM3342/42889装架为不同参考。颅250毫米是图尺投影估值；身体尺寸是符合馆方小马级描述的复原估值，非实测骨长。软组织、耳形、尾被毛与颜色为推断。

scale.status: Skull approximate image-ruler projection from AMNH1480 (10cm bar), not caliper measurement. Wholebody and tail estimates use AMNH pony-size description and skeletal proportions; perspective mount not used as exact ruler.

diagnostic_targets: Slender long limbs with substantial clearance below ribcage, unlike a barrel-bodied short-legged Teleoceras or hippo-like Metamynodon.
No nasal or frontal horn: smooth nasal silhouette.
Three distinct short hoofed toes on all FOUR feet, broad central toe and smaller flanking toes; not horse single hoof.
Moderately long neck and relatively large deep-cheeked head with constricted muzzle, not tiny deer head or giant Paraceratherium neck.
Compact non-barrel torso, visible shoulder/hip limb transitions, thin moderately long tail.
Conservative neutral coat, no exact copying of artist striping or unsupported horn/tusk ornament.
acceptance: Gray check against real skull and skeleton before final views; original slender longleg hornless combination preserved.
Four feet each have three toes, visible in exactGLB front/side/perspective views without extra default renders.
Differentiate from shortleg rhinos by body-limb proportions, not color/size alone.
Two isolated builds, proper dependency closure and independent review required.
